Before you can enter these instanced dungeons, you will also need to have a &ePearl of Home&r in your inventory, to ensure you can return safely.

Right-click the &eMap Device&r to interact with it. Here, you can insert your Map item in the top slot. &cIgnore the Atlas button and the bottom 4 slots for now.&r Click on &eInitiate Map&r to start the instance!
Once you're in, kill mobs and loot chests to increase your &eexploration progress&r! Once you've explored enough, you'll be able to &eteleport to the Boss room&r to complete the Map.
&eRequires ALL dependencies to be completed.&r

quests.title: Dungeon Delving Basics
quests.subtitle: Lost Page
description: Maps will have an associated Rarity and Tier. The Rarity and Tier determine the difficulty of mobs, and quality of loot.
&7Common&r - Tier 0-10
&aUncommon&r - Tier 11-20
&9Rare&r - Tier 21-40
&dEpic&r - Tier 41-60
&6Legendary&r - Tier 61-80
&5Mythic&r - Tier 81-100
Maps can also roll various affixes. &eAffixes&r are random modifiers that are applied either to the players (usually negative) or the mobs (usually positive).
Additionally, Maps have a set number of "&bEntry Tickets&r" which decrease as the Map rarity increases. This &climits the number of times you can enter your Map&r, so be careful!
Tickets are shared between party members.

quests.title: Dragon Quest
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: This is it! &eKill the Ender Dragon&r and put an "end" to this madness!
&cThe Ender Dragon spawns at minimum level 50.&r
The Ender Dragon Has:
&b+25%% Physical Damage converted to Lightning Damage&r
&b+25%% Physical Damage converted to Chaos Damage&r
&b+25%% Elemental Resistance&r
&b+35%% Chaos Resistance&r
&a7.5%% Chance of Dropping End Rune&r

quests.title: Summoning Ritual
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: You received &einstructions&r from a village guard, scribbled on a loose piece of bamboo.
&o1. Arrive in The End.&r
&o2. Obtain End Crystals from the island.&r
&o3. Place the crystals on the -&r
The rest has been &erubbed off &rfrom your adventures.

quests.title: Beyond
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: You've slain the dragon, but it seems like there's more to The End than you thought. It might be a good time to use your newly found &eElytra&r and &eexplore the outer islands&r.
&6This Quest Unlocks New Shops In the Campaign Shop.

quests.title: Genetic Modification
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: You learned that it wasn't the Ender Dragon that was causing the rifts to open. As vile as the beast was, it was just that - a vile beast.
It seems there is more to The End than you thought... Some say another danger lurks in the void, and others say throwing a &eMysterious Worm&r into it will draw it out.
You can obtain a &eMysterious Worm&r by killing the &eEnder Dragon&r.

quests.title: Worm from the Void
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: Be prepared, as this horrific creature has many parts to its body. Additionally, it will fire homing crystals at nearby players. If you get too close you'll get knocked back. Be careful not to get knocked off the island!
&cThe Void Worm spawns at minimum level 55.&r
The Void Worm Has:
&b+25%% Elemental Resistance&r
&a5%% Chance of Dropping End Rune&r

quests.title: Back Home
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: There are reports of an underground creature wreaking havoc among the resident spelunkers. Some call it a &e"Warden"&r and say it can be found in the &eAncient City&r deep underneath.

quests.title: Dimension Guardian
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: The &eWarden&r is completely blind, and relies on vibrations, smell, and touch to detect players. You can evade them by sneaking, or using diversions such as arrows. It has a powerful melee attack, and can release a devastating homing sonic boom attack.
&cThe Warden spawns at minimum level 60.&r
The Warden Has:
&b+50%% Physical to Chaos Damage&r
&b+50%% Armor&r
&b+35%% Elemental Resistance&r
&b+35%% Chaos Resistance&r
&a10%% Chance of Dropping Sid Rune&r

rewards.name: Loot crate: Reset Potion Package (5 Items)

quests.title: The Otherside
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: Wow, who'd have thought? The &eWarden&r seemed to be protecting a gateway to a new &eundiscovered dimension&r. What's on &eThe Otherside&r?

To reach &eThe Otherside&r, you will first need the &eHeart of the Deep&r from the &eWarden&r. Use this heart on the &ereinforced deepslate&r of the portal to ignite it. Make sure to first clear off all the sculk and obstructions from the inner frame!

quests.title: Untied Loose Ends
quests.subtitle: Main Quest
description: Continue to &eexplore,&r and descend into the &edarkness...&r Find the &eAncient Temple&r - you never know what &egoodies&r you'll find.

&b&oCongratulations on completing the main Campaign! Continue onto the Epilogue for completion or move on to explore what the worlds have to offer. Be sure to check out the Side Quests! Keep on leveling and customizing your character, and try to overcome the greatest challenges in Maps!&r&r

tasks.name: Abyssal Descent
tasks.detail: Explore the depths for a temple

quests.title: Dragonspawn
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: Although you've &eslain the dragon&r, you will still find remnants of the beast. Slay its &espawn&r to prevent any further devastation.
Note that you can &erespawn&r the Ender Dragon again using &eEnd Crystals&r! The method is the same as &eVanilla.&r
&o&7Completion unlocks a Repeatable Quest in the Repeatables Chapter!&r&r

quests.title: They Knew You Were Coming
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: Rumours have it that &eFarseer&r are prophetic creatures originating from the void.
&o&7Completion unlocks a Repeatable Quest in the Repeatables Chapter!&r&r

quests.title: Complete All Act V Quests!
quests.subtitle: Achievement
description: &eComplete&r all of the &equests&r in Act V to complete this achievement. Then show it off with your new hat!

quests.title: Viral Disaster
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: &eEnderiophages&r can be found where &eChorus Fruit grows&r. These things spread &edisease&r and should be taken care of as soon as possible! Enderiophages can be built by placing an &eEnd Rod with a Capsid on top and placing an Eye of Ender inside&r.

quests.title: Death Traps
quests.subtitle: Deeper and Darker
description: &eShriek Worms&r are terrifying creatures found on &eThe Otherside&r. Should you &estep on Infested Sculk&r, you'll be met with a surprise.

quests.title: Uncanny Presence
quests.subtitle: Deeper and Darker
description: &eStalkers&r are creepy and powerful entities that can be found on &eThe Otherside&r. They're attracted to harsh noises, so if you're looking to find one, maybe &ebreak some jars&r?
If you're not having any luck, consider the &eGateway of Darkness&r.
&eRequires ALL dependencies to be completed.&r

quests.title: The Hopeless
quests.subtitle: Deeper and Darker
description: In &eEchoing Forests&r, you'll find creatures that have lost their souls. Once thought to be human, now a husk of its former self.

quests.title: A Race Against the Clock
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: Catch the Ender Flu effect. Cure it by eating many &eChorus Fruit&r or &edrinking Milk&r. The clock is ticking...

tasks.name: Race Against The Clock
tasks.detail: Catch the Ender Flu effect. Cure it by eating many Chorus Fruit or drinking milk. Be sure not to let it run its toll!

quests.title: Disenchanter
quests.subtitle: Utilities
description: Despite its expensive ingredients, the &eDisenchanter&r allows you to take all the enchantments off of an item for a &edurability cost&r.

rewards.name: Loot crate: Reset Potion Package (5 Items)

quests.title: Structures Beyond Reach
quests.subtitle: Outer End
description: Two new structures can be found in the End: &eEnd Tower and Catacombs&r. You can find fun new loot in these structures, as well as &ePurpur Golems&r!
The Purpur Golem Has:
&b+30%% Armor&r
&b+25%% Chaos Resistance&r

quests.title: Residents of the Void
quests.subtitle: Outer End
description: You'll find &eStalkers, Entombed&r, and many other vicious creatures of the void in new End biomes. Check out the &eAzure Forest, Crystal Crag, and Primordial Pools&r!

quests.title: Boxed In
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: The Shelterer is an interesting creature that can be found in the &eEnd Dungeon&r. By releasing it with a &eNether Star&r on its &eAltar&r, it will be able to lock itself in an energetic shulker box.
The Shelterer Has:
&b+100%% Health&r
&b+25%% Damage Supression Chance&r
&a15%% Chance of Dropping End Rune&r

quests.title: Otherworldly Beings IV
quests.subtitle: Endventure
description: After slaying &ePhantom Creepers&r in the &eNether&r, you've found yourself face-to-face with them again in &eThe End&r!
&ePhantom Creepers&r spawn in &eWarped Forests&r and &eThe End&r. They split upon contact, so you'll need to handle them with care!
The Phantom Creeper Has:
&b+25%% Dodge Rating&r

quests.title: Dimensional Travel
quests.subtitle: Mapping
description: Before warping dimensions again, you should better familiarize with the &eMap Device&r.

You may have already noticed that the &eAtlas button&r in your &eMap Device&r brings up a huge tree. This is the &cAtlas&r, an account-wide tree where you complete Maps to unlock newer Map layouts and eventually &eAtlas Passive points&r. Spend these points on nodes to buff your Map!
The pool of Maps you can roll is limited to Map nodes that are unlocked. Completing them unlocks more variants and &estarting with Tier 20+&r, rewards you with &c1 Atlas Passive&r.
You can access the Atlas Passive tree by clicking the button in the top-left of the Atlas. Here, you can allocate points to &emodify how your Maps will behave&r.

quests.title: Map Exploration
quests.subtitle: Lost Page
description: As you're killing mobs and exploring the Map, you will notice your kill and loot percent increasing. These two metrics contribute to your total &eexploration rarity&r. The higher your exploration, the better the rewards will be for killing the &eMap Boss&r. As you explore more, your exploration rarity will start to go up, starting with &auncommon&r exploration as the first milestone.

quests.title: There's Levels to This...
quests.subtitle: Mapping
description: While exploring &eThe Otherside&r, it may be prudent to go back to Maps to strengthen yourself. Luckily, you learned about empowered dimensions from your travels.
Starting at &elevel 50&r, Maps can start rolling various &e"League"&r events that spice up the dungeon run. Complete these events for specialized rewards.
Here is a brief overview of the 6 events you can encounter in Maps. You should already be familiar with &eHarvests&r and &eAncient Obeslisks&r!
1. &2Harvest&r - kill waves of enemies for powerful materials.
2. &cAncient Obelisks&r - survive the onslaught to earn currency.
3. &dProphecy&r - kill enemies in the Map to earn coins for a specialized shop.
4. &bImprisoned Monsters&r - unleash a powerful mob and kill it for potential rewards.
5. &7Strongboxes&r - kill the box's guardians for catered rewards.
6. &eShrines&r - use the shrine to provide yourself with powerful buffs.
For more detail on each individual mechanic, you can refer to the connected &bLost Pages&r.

quests.title: League Events
quests.subtitle: Lost Page
description: Within Mine and Slash Maps, there are additional events that can occur. Each Map &emay have multiple mechanics active&r. You will have already seen two of them which were available to spawn starting at level 50.
&2Harvest&r (&bLv. 50+&r): find portals in Maps that will bring you to a new Harvest room. Kill mobs in these rooms to earn &eChaotic Gems&r which are used to craft special currencies!

&cAncient Obelisk&r (&bLv. 50+&r): similar to Harvest, find portals which will bring you to an arena. Tackle waves of enemies to find upgrades that can be used on &eObelisks&r! You'll also have the opportunity to earn special currency that can upgrade &eSupport and Augment Gems&r.
&eShrines&r (&3Lv. 60+&r): find shrines throughout Maps that can be interacted with to provide yourself and nearby allies with a buff. This buff lasts 60s and can make a Map become trivial!

quests.title: League Events II
quests.subtitle: Lost Page
description: Other events will start appearing at level 60. These also have a unique reward structure!

&dProphecy&r (&3Lv. 60+&r): interact with an altar to initiate &dProphecy&r. The altar allows you to choose from Curses that you can apply to yourself. While you have a Curse active, mobs will drop &eProphecy Coins&r. The more curses you have on yourself, the more &eProphecy Coins&r you can earn. Use these coins to purchase rewards in the Hub. Note that &6Legendary&r and &5Mythic&r rewards only appear starting in Tier 20 and 40 maps, respectively.

&7Strongboxes&r (&3Lv. 60+&r): find &7Strongboxes&r throughout the Map. Interacting with one will summon &7Strongbox&r guardians. Defeat them, and reap specialized rewards. The rewards will consist of a pool of one type of item (eg. a bunch of &eCurrency&r, or a bunch of &eRunes&r).

&bImprisoned Monsters&r (&3Lv. 60+&r): sometimes in a Map, you'll run across a caged mob block. Interacting with it will free the mob which upon defeat, have a chance to drop special &eCurrency&r that can &erestore gear potential&r! Be warned though, these mobs are not for the faint of heart.

quests.title: Relics of the Past
quests.subtitle: Mapping
description: Looking to challenge yourself even further? In addition to &cAtlas Passives&r, you can modify your Maps using &eRelics&r. By now, you should have quite a few &eRelics&r earned from chests and &eBoss&r kills. Slot the Relics into the &eMap Device&r (or Harvest/Obelisk block) in the 2x2 grid known as the &e"Relic Inventory"&r.
&eRelics&r possess the power to anchor a specific &eLeague&r event to your map. This artifact holds 3 charges before shattering.
In the inventory, you can place &eRelics&r to enhance the dungeon. Note that &cRelics have multiple uses before they're consumed&r and you may only place one &eRelic&r in the &eMap Device&r.

quests.title: The Pinnacle
quests.subtitle: Mapping
description: You hear whispers of a powerful force deep in the void.. Continue exploring the &cAtlas&r and complete the toughest Maps to seek more information...

&cUber Maps&r are extremely difficult and rewarding Maps. A regular &5Tier 80+ Map&r can be upgraded into an &cUber Map&r using an &eAdventure Map Uber Upgrade&r item. You can craft these with &eUber Fragments&r which drop from Map Bosses.
&cUber Maps&r contain &cUber Bosses&r, which drop very &epowerful Jewels&r.

By finishing the &cAtlas&r, which requires the completion of &cUber Maps&r, you unlock the &oprivilege&r to challenge the &4Pinnacle Boss&r. Similar to an &cUber&r, you can craft the &eAdventure Map Pinnacle Upgrade&r item to modify your Map.
&4Pinnacle Bosses&r are extremely difficult and also have a huge reward. But, &odo you have what it takes to find out what?&r

quests.title: Primal Evils
quests.subtitle: The Final Lost Page
description: At long last... your notes from your various adventures have brought you to &eThe Otherside&r.

From your humble beginnings in the &eOverworld&r, perilous journey through the &eNether&r and &eUnderdark&r, encounters in the &eEverbright and Everdawn&r, and close calls in &eThe End&r, you are now at what you believe to be the source of the evil.

What did that researcher back at the village call it? A "quarrel" amongst the &bPrimal Titans&r? According to the researcher, it should be enough to just eliminate the four elemental creatures found in &eThe End&r and &eThe Otherside&r.
Get ready to embark on your final quest! There's no way they'll come back after killing them, right..?

quests.title: The Frozen Tower
quests.subtitle: Cold
description: The &eNight Lich&r resides in the &eLich Tower&r found in &eCrystal Crags&r in &eThe End&r. To find the structure, you can craft &eSoul Stars&r. Using the &eSoul Star&r will consume it to indicate the direction of the nearest &eLich Tower&r!
&cThe Night Lich spawns at minimum level of 90 and at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Night Lich Has:
&b+50%% Physical to Cold Damage&r
&b+50%% Freeze Chance&r
&b+25%% Shatter Chance&r
&b+50%% Elemental Resistance&r
&a15%% Chance of Dropping Sid Rune&r

quests.title: The Ardent Depths
quests.subtitle: Fire
description: The &eNether Gauntlet&r can be found in &eGauntlet Arenas&r located in the &eBlooming Caverns&r biome of &eThe Otherside&r.
&cThe Nether Gauntlet spawns at minimum level of 90 and at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Nether Gauntlet Has:
&b+50%% Physical to Fire Damage&r
&b+75%% Burn Chance&r
&b+40%% Dodge&r
&b+75%% Fire Resistance&r
&a15%% Chance of Dropping Sid Rune&r

quests.title: The Sprawling Vinelands
quests.subtitle: Chaos
description: You can find the &eVoid Blossom&r in the &eEchoing Forests&r of &eThe Otherside&r. You can use &eVoid Lilies&r to indicate the direction to these &eVoid Blossoms&r.
&cThe Void Blossom spawns at minimum level of 90 and at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Void Blossom Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Chaos Damage&r
&b+33%% Poison Chance&r
&b+1%% of Health Regenerated Per Second&r
&b+75%% Chaos Resistance&r
&c-25%% Fire Resistance&r
&a15%% Chance of Dropping Sid Rune&r

quests.title: The Galvanic Stronghold
quests.subtitle: Lightning
description: The &eObsidilith&r resides in the &eObsidilith Arena&r found in &ePrimordial Pools&r in &eThe End&r. Bring an &eEye of Ender&r and use it to activate the altar!
&cThe Obsidilith spawns at minimum level of 90 and at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Obsidilith Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Lightning Damage&r
&b+50%% Electrify Chance&r
&b+25%% Shock Chance&r
&b+100%% Armor&r
&b+50%% Lightning Resist&r
&a15%% Chance of Dropping Sid Rune&r

quests.title: They're Back!
quests.subtitle: Resetting Boss Structures
description: Someone already cleared out a structure before you got there? You can use &eBrimstone Nectar&r on any of the &bPrimal Titans' structures&r to reset them!

quests.title: The Unknown Beyond
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: As you go through Map after Map, you hear echoes of another &eLich&r... One that can be found in the &eTwilight Forest&r. A new portal appears and you step through to find a whole new dimension.

To enter the Twilight Forest, you need to create a 2x2 shallow pool of water in a grassy area, surrounded by plants and/or leaves in &eThe Otherside&r. You may need to bring grass with you. Then throw in a diamond and watch the portal form.
&l&cMobs from Twilight Forest spawn at a minimum of level 90!&r&r

quests.title: Natural Mazes
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: Nestled in small clearings throughout the &eTwilight Forest&r, &eHedge Mazes&r are a curious sight for new explorers in the dimension. Much like the ruined standing stones, monuments and other landmarks that dot the landscape, there has been endless speculation on why these mazes were built, but no answers have been found to date.

Hedge blocks form the walls of a typical maze, with dense, prickly foliage to deter adventurers from simply chopping their way through the twisting corridors. Fireflies and Jack-o-Lanterns are common, helping to light up the maze in contrast to the dim light elsewhere. Canopy Trees have been sometimes seen in a maze, forming a kind of tall post in the hedge walls.

The other main feature common to hedge mazes are the small open "rooms" within the maze. These have been found to always contain a magical spawner, as well as 1-2 chests and more Jack-o-Lanterns. Typically, they generate &eHostile Wolves, Swarm Spiders or Hedge Spiders&r but unlike spawners found elsewhere, bright light does not prevent them from functioning.

quests.title: Unbridled Aggression
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eHostile Wolves&r are strange Wolves that can only be found in a &eHedge Maze&r. Legend says these Wolves hate humans because they always steal their treasures. Unfortunately, these Wolves cannot be tamed.

quests.title: Trapped
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eHedge Spiders&r are almost identical to normal overworld Spiders aside from their distinct green color. The only difference between this species and their Overworld counterparts is that they are able to spawn in brightly-lit &eHedge Mazes&r. Legend says these Spiders are brave enough to protect their treasure from explorers.

quests.title: A Small Mound
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: Rising out of the otherwise flat terrain of the &eTwilight Forest&r, &eHollow Hills&r are conspicuous mounds of dirt that conceal a vast hollow cave packed with stalactites and stalagmites, some of which are formed with precious ores and minerals. Explorers have found these large dome-shaped hills in three distinct sizes, large enough to be detected and marked on a &eMagic Map&r, with an appropriate icon indicating its size. Some hills have been found to have other caves and ravines cutting into them, so those adventurers tunneling beneath the earth may find themselves inside one of these hills in their explorations.

Small hills measure approximately 30 metres across and usually contain the basic minerals such as Coal, Iron, with Redstone and Glowstone occasionally being found. Explorers can expect to find a couple of treasure chests containing common tools and items such as food, arrows, ladders and torches, but rarely, a valuable Ore Magnet may be found along with a Diamond and &eSteeleaf&r. &eSwarm Spiders, Redcap Goblins and Kobolds&r reside in these hills, with other creatures common to the Overworld as well.

quests.title: Solely Snakular
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eNaga Courtyard&r is a large, walled-off structure built from various forms of stone and Nagastone. Inside the Naga Courtyard, there are various hedges of Twilight Oak Leaves, pillars of Polished Andesite and Etched Nagastone, and additional decorative features. In the middle of the structure is a Boss Spawner containing the &eNaga&r.
Slaying the Naga will unlock the next structure in Progression, the &eLich Tower&r, removing the structure's protection.
&cThe Naga spawns at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Naga Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Chaos Damage&r
&b+40%% Poison Chance&r
&b+30%% Chaos Penetration&r
&b+50%% Cold Resistance&r
&b+50%% Chaos Resistance&r

quests.title: The Tower of Power
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eLich Tower&r consists of a single central spire, from which many smaller towers and chambers jut out haphazardly from the sides, connecting directly into the next tower or via bridge.

Numerous hostile mobs spawn in the Lich Tower normally or through spawners. The usual assortment of vanilla mobs naturally spawn. The &eDeath Tome&r also spawns in the Lich Tower, and is the only structure to find this mob.
In order to unlock the Lich Tower, the &eNaga&r must be defeated.
The Lich Tower is also key to unlocking three other biomes and structures:
- Dispelling the mosquito swarm around the &eTwilight Swamp&r, allowing exploration into the &eLabyrinth&r.
- Dispelling the darkness covering the &eDark Forest&r, allowing exploration into the &eGoblin Knight Stronghold&r.
- Dispelling the blizzard over the &eSnowy Forest&r, allowing entry into the &eYeti Cave&r.

quests.title: Enchanted Library
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eDeath Tomes&r are dangerous books float in the staircases and libraries of the Lich Tower. They fire a projectile that slows the creature they hit for a brief time. Death Tomes occasionally lose pages when struck.
Death Tomes may also drop a &eMagic Map Focus&r upon death.
The Death Tome Has:
&b+50%% Physical to Lightning Damage&r
&b+50%% Physical to Chaos Damage&r

quests.title: The Master Mastermind
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eTwilight Lich&r, also referred to as just the &eLich&r, resides on the top of a &eLich Tower&r. It appears as a tall humanoid skeleton wearing a purple cape, and a large golden crown. Surrounding itself is a wall of shields to protect itself from any damage, but maybe they can be broken.
Adventurers report that the projectiles can be deflected with a properly-timed swing. Every time the player reflects the Lich's projectiles back at it, it will remove one of its shields.
&cThe Lich spawns at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Lich Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Lightning Damage&r
&b+50%% Electrify Chance&r
&b+25%% Shock Chance&r
&b+25%% Lightning Penetration&r
&b+75%% Elemental Resistance&r
&b+50%% Chaos Resistance&r
&6This Quest Unlocks New Shops In the Campaign Shop.

quests.title: A Medium Mound
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eHollow Hills&r are an excellent source of ores to be mined and treasures to be looted, with the more valuable loot contained in the larger hills. The treasure to be found tend to be guarded by the dangerous creatures abound in the darkness, which can easily spell the doom of an unwary explorer. Unfortunately, it also seems that the larger the hill, the more creatures that live there. Explorers should remember the basic rules of caving, and never tunnel directly down into a Hollow Hill; instead, approach from the side and bring plenty of light sources to illuminate the interior as various spawners are around every corner.

Medium hills are about 60 metres in diameter, and 25+ metres tall in the center. The interior becomes more spacious, but this has also attracted more and deadlier creatures. Gold and Lapis can be found here as well as Diamond and Emerald being seen, albeit rarely. As the value of the ores increase, so do the treasures - up to 6 chests can usually be found in a medium hill containing &eIronwood Ingots and Transformation Powder&r, along with unique artifacts such as a Moonworm Queen, and the Peacock Feather Fan. &eFire Beetles and Redcap Sappers&r live in medium hills, in addition to those seen in small hills.

quests.title: A Magic Maze
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eLabyrinth&r is a major landmark tied to Progression. It appears as an unremarkable small hill in the &eTwilight Swamp&r, but opens up to an entrance to an underground structure of sprawling maze passages. In the deep levels of the Labyrinth, a fenced-off room contains a Boss Spawner with the &eMinoshroom&r.

quests.title: Mooooooooo
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eMinoshroom&r is a mini-boss found lurking in its prison at the bottom of a &eLabyrinth&r. The &eMinoshroom&r is a bizarre hybrid of a Mooshroom and a Minotaur.
The Minoshroom Has:
&b+10 Armor Penetration (Scales)&r
&b+50%% Accuracy&r
&b+30%% Physical Resistance&r
&b+20%% Health Regeneration&r

quests.title: Concrete... Slime?
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eMaze Slimes&r are &eTwilight Forest&r variants of the Overworld Slime. These Slimes have a gray color and spawn in &eLabyrinths&r.
The Maze Slime Has:
&b+25%% Armor&r
&b+25%% Physical Resistance&r
&b+50%% Lightning Resistance&r

quests.title: The Lair
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: Resembling a large &eHollow Hill&r, the &eHydra Lair&r looms out of the flat swamplands providing a natural lair for the multi-headed Hydra at the heart of the &eFire Swamp&r. The &eHydra&r seems to have hollowed out the hill itself, providing it with shelter and forcing anyone who would challenge it to approach it head on. The area that faces the Hydra is also bereft of vegetation or cover, so that there is nowhere to hide.

quests.title: Multi-Headed Beast
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eHydra&r can be found in a unique, cracked-open &eHydra Lair&r in a &eFire Swamp&r. The Hydra appears as a massive creature, with two stumpy legs supporting a wide, scaly body. Multiple serpentine necks end in heads that bear a passing resemblance to that of the Ender Dragon. The entire creature is covered in blue-green and dark blue scales.
&cThe Hydra spawns at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Hydra Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Fire Damage&r
&b+60%% Burn Chance&r
&b+40%% Fire Penetration&r
&b+25%% Damage Reduction&r
&b+35%% Lightning Resistance&r

quests.title: A Hearty Meal
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eMeef Stroganoff&r can be quite filling and potent, allowing any adventurer the energy to explore even the hottest of biomes after eating a single bowl.
Upon consuming &eMeef Stroganoff&r, the player is granted access to both the &eFire Swamp&r and the &eHydra&r.

quests.title: Blinded By Darkness
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eDark Forest&r is a densely vegetated biome with a thick canopy that blocks almost all light from the forest floor. Darkwood Trees grow most commonly in this biome, with some smaller vegetation such as tall grass and flowers covering the grass. Occasionally, Mushglooms grow in the area, providing a faint source of light.

Despite the darkness, monsters such as Zombies and Skeletons will not spawn on the surface. However, other monsters such as &eMist Wolves&r and &eKing Spiders&r will spawn, making traversal in the Dark Forest more dangerous.

quests.title: Hidden In The Mist
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eMist Wolves&r are mysterious monsters that spawn in the &eDark Forest&r. These monsters wait for their victim in the darkness of the forest. They will turn transparent in the dark, and only take solid form in areas of bright light. If they attack a player in the dark, their attacks can blind the player, but this affliction doesn't seem to happen near a light source.
The Mist Wolf Has:
&b+50%% Physical to Chaos Damage&r
&b+30%% Dodge Rating&r
&b+30%% Spell Dodge Rating&r
&b+25%% Elemental Resistance&r

quests.title: Fear-Inducing Spiders
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eKing Spiders&r can only be found in the &eDark Forest&r and the first sign of them is usually their red eyes glowing in the darkness. They are twice the size, speed and toughness of normal spiders, and are found with a &eSkeleton Druid&r riding on their back, making them a formidable foe to deal with.
The King Spider Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Chaos Damage&r
&b+30%% Chaos Penetration&r

quests.title: Goblin Usurpers
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: Ancient and forlorn, the &eGoblin Knight Strongholds&r rest amongst the unnaturally dense canopy of the &eDark Forest&r. They can be difficult to spot amongst the darkness with little remaining above ground apart from broken walls and cracked bricks. Beneath the surface however, is a vast complex of rooms and hallways and tombs.

quests.title: Cursed Knights
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eKnight Phantoms&r reside in a brick-layered room in the &eGoblin Knight Stronghold&r. They appear as ghostly pieces of Phantom Armor, and appear to have a spooky, ghost-like look when attacking.
Defeating the &e6 Knight Phantoms&r will progress the Dark Forest Phase, thus removing the protections over the &eDark Forest Center&r, now allowing access to the &eUr-Ghast&r and its &eDark Tower&r.
The Knight Phantom Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Lightning Damage&r
&b+25%% Critical Hit&r
&b+50%% Dodge Rating&r
&b+50%% Spell Dodge Rating&r

quests.title: Dark Spires
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: Rising ominously over the &eDark Forest&r are the awe-inspiring &eDark Towers&r. So tall that they seem to pierce the sky itself, these immense constructions contain all manner of unique rooms, obstacles, treasure and monsters to explore and fight on the epic journey to the top. They are generally found at the very heart of a Dark Forest, where the thick, choking foliage becomes a strange, autumn-like hue, perhaps due to the sinister influence of the Tower.
&eCarminite creatures mostly deal Fire Damage.&r

quests.title: Blood, or Carminite?
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eUr-Ghast&r can be found flying around at the top of the gigantic &eDark Tower&r. It appears as a large, supernatural creature with many large, waving tentacles. It is covered in what adventurers fear is blood, or could be Carminite. This creature resembles the Carminite Ghastguard, due to their ability to stalk players, as well as the Nether-exclusive Ghasts, but is much larger and much more dangerous.
&cThe Ur-Ghast spawns at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Ur-Ghast Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Fire Damage&r
&b+25%% Burn Chance&r
&b+100%% Burn Damage&r
&b+5%% Maximum Fire Resistance&r
&b+100%% Fire Resistance&r

quests.title: Snowed In
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eSnowy Forest&r is an unnaturally cold biome that stands in stark contrast to much of the rest of the Twilight Forest dimension. Explorers have noted many similarities to the Overworld Snowy Taiga biome, with snow covering the ground between large stands of spruce trees growing in place of the usual Canopy Trees, with some growing just as large. Why such an icy climate should exist in a predominantly mild and wet dimension is a mystery, though some suspect the large &eGlacier&r that nestles amongst the fir trees may have something to do with it.

Care must be taken when trekking through these areas, as &eWinter Wolves&r roam the land along with dangerous &eYetis&r. These creatures should be approached cautiously, especially when delving into the &eYeti Caves&r, as many dozens can be found in these icy caves. The &eAlpha Yeti&r who claim dominion over their kin will not take kindly to intrusion from the curious, or the foolish.

quests.title: A Chilling Awooo
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eWinter Wolves&r are large, bluish-white canines that live in the &eSnowy Forest&r. These monsters resembles their &eDark Forest&r counterparts, but with a white coat. They pursue and attack players in their territory, attacking with both their bite and with a freezing breath attack that applies a slow.
The Winter Wolf Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Cold Damage&r
&b+30%% Cold Penetration&r
&b+30%% Cold Resistance&r

quests.title: The Yeti
quests.subtitle: Twilight Forest
description: &eYeti&r are large, white, blocky creatures that live in the &eSnowy Forest&r or within the &eYeti Cave&r. They are semi-passive in nature, only taking interest in players that move within about 4 blocks of them. They have no directly damaging attacks. Instead, they will pick up their target and throw them in a random direction. Adventurers will not be directly harmed by a Yeti, but the fall damage will hurt. If attacked, they will become aggressive, pursuing their target.
The Yeti Has:
&b+0.5%% of Health Regenerated Per Second&r
&b+30%% Cold Resistance&r

quests.title: The Alpha Yeti
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The fearsome &eAlpha Yeti&r is much larger than the rest of the Yetis in its pack. It has six large blue horns and is constantly aggressive towards players.
Defeating the &eAlpha Yeti&r will remove the protections over the &eGlacier&r, now allowing access to the &eSnow Queen&r and its &eAurora Palace&r.
The Alpha Yeti Has:
&b+50%% Physical to Cold Damage&r
&b+8 Armor Penetration (Scales)&r
&b+30%% Cold Penetration&r
&b+25%% Physical Resistance&r
&b+50%% Cold Resistance&r

quests.title: A Palace of Beauty
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: Standing over the desolate &eGlaciers&r, the &eAurora Palace&r is a striking and beautiful sight for adventurers in the Twilight Forest, with its walls constantly shifting in a variety of colours reaching into the sky. Beauty is only skin deep sadly, as there are dangers within who will not hesitate to defend their magical home.

Adventurers who defeat the &eAlpha Yeti&r will find that just &etouching his downy fur&r will transfer a portion of the magical power from the fur to themselves, dispelling the winds and leaving the Palace open for exploration.

quests.title: The Queen of Ice
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: The &eSnow Queen&r is found in an ice-encrusted room near the top of the &eAurora Palace&r. She is perhaps the most human-like creature encountered in the Twilight Forest, resembling a woman, but with large violet eyes and pale blue skin. She is immediately hostile towards any intruders in her vicinity, launching quickly into one of three main attack patterns.

The Snow Queen flies on a saucer-shaped sled of magical ice blocks. The sled serves a powerful defense, both moving the Queen up and out of range of close-range attacks, while &eblocking any ranged attacks made from below&r. To successfully attack the Snow Queen, you must anticipate her movements, &eattacking only when she moves close enough that you can get around the ice sled&r.
&cThe Snow Queen spawns at Mythic Rarity.&r
The Snow Queen Has:
&b+100%% Physical to Cold Damage&r
&b+80%% Freeze Chance&r
&b+25%% Shatter Chance&r
&b+30%% Cold Penetration&r
&b+30%% Damage Reduction&r

quests.subtitle: Achievement
description: Defeat all of the &eTwilight Forest&r bosses in the Epilogue to complete this achievement. Then show it off with your new hat!

quests.title: A Cold, Humble Abode
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: Nestled among the hills and fir trees of the &eSnowy Forest&r, the &eYeti Cave&r appears as a square-shaped hill. Four entrances allow access to the ice-covered insides, where packed ice hangs from stalactites and covers the floor. Many fierce &eYetis&r make their home in these frigid caves, lorded over by an &eAlpha Yeti&r.

quests.title: Nomadic Travels
quests.subtitle: Epilogue
description: &oFind certain structures and kill bosses? Seems easy enough... You pull out your Explorer's Compass and- wait what? It doesn't work?&r
In the Twilight Forest, you'll need to rely on your navigation skills. You'll need to rely on Twilight Forest the &eMap Focus&r!

quests.title: Salvaging
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: Salvaging is the act of deconstructing your gear into materials that can be used to craft Profession items, gear, or repair.

Interact with the Salvaging Station and place items into it to start Salvaging. The station is also compatible with Hoppers. Salvaging in the Station can yield more results and experience than auto-salvaging.

Your gear will be salvaged and you will receive materials as the output. &eWhen salvaging, you will receive &eStones&r of varying rarity. These are used to repair or craft gear. They can also be used to craft other items. The rarity of the stone depends on the rarity of the gear salvaged.
&bYou can also salvage your gear via the Hub auto-salvaging feature, but you will earn less experience doing so.&r

quests.title: Gear Crafting
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: You can craft &eCrafted Gear Souls&r for the following: armor, offhands, jewelry, and weapons. When crafting gear, there are a few ingredients:
1. &eTiered Ore&r - earned from Mining, they are based on the item level you want to craft. The level ranges are the same as what you'd find in the Mining Profession.
2. &eStones (Rarity)&r - the Stones determine the rarity of the gear you will craft. You can get these Stones while salvaging. The amount of Stones required depends on the rarity of the gear.
3. &eIngots + Identifier Items&r - the items that determine whether you are crafting armor, offhands, jewelry, or weapons. Refer to &cJEI&r for recipes!
4. &eMoney&r
&lYou can always check the &cJEI&r &lto see what items are needed for &eCrafted Gear Soul&r&l.&r

rewards.name: All of: Gear Crafting Starter Kit

quests.title: Cooking
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: You can cook foods which will provide hunger and saturation, but also provide stat boosts. When cooking, there are a few ingredients:

1. &eTiered Meat/Produce/Fish&r - earned from Bounty Hunting, Farming, and Fishing they are based on the item level you want to craft. The level ranges are the same as what you'd find in the gathering Professions. The type of food you use depends on what food you cook:
&cMeat&r: Health/Magic Shield Regen
&2Produce&r: Mana/Energy Regen
&bFish&r: EXP/Loot
2. &c1&r &eStone (Rarity)&r - the Stones determine the rarity of the gear you will craft. You can get these Stones while salvaging.
3. &eOther Food Item&r - generally used as an additional ingredient that can also determine what food you're cooking. Refer to &cJEI&r for recipes!
4. &eMoney&r
&lYou can always check the &cJEI&r &lto see what items are needed for &eCooking&r&l.&r
&eRequires 1 dependency to be completed.&r

quests.title: Alchemy
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: You can brew potions which can recover health and resources, or provide stat boosts. When brewing, there are a few ingredients:

1. &eTiered Meat/Produce/Fish&r - earned from Bounty Hunting, Farming, and Fishing they are based on the item level you want to craft. The level ranges are the same as what you'd find in the gathering Professions. The type of food you use depends on what potion you brew:
&cMeat&r: Health/Resource Potion
&2Produce&r: Core Stat Potion
&bFish&r: Damage Buff Potion
2. &c1&r &eStone (Rarity)&r - the Stones determine the rarity of the gear you will craft. You can get these Stones while salvaging.
3. 1-2 &eOther Food Items&r - used as an additional ingredient. Refer to &cJEI&r for recipes!
4. &eMoney&r
&lYou can always check the &cJEI&r &lto see what items are needed for &eAlchemy&r&l.&r

quests.title: Infusing

description: You can craft &eInfusions&r for the following: armor, offhands, jewelry, and weapons. When crafting the scrolls, there are a few ingredients:
1. &eTiered Ore&r - earned from Mining, they are based on the item level you want to craft. The level ranges are the same as what you'd find in the Mining Profession.
2. &eStones (Rarity)&r - the Stones determine the rarity of the gear you will craft. You can get these Stones while salvaging.
3. &eIngots + Identifier Items&r - the items that determine whether you are crafting armor, offhands, jewelry, or weapons. Refer to &cJEI&r for recipes
4. &ePaper&r
5. &eMoney&r
&lYou can always check the &cJEI&r &lto see what items are needed for &eInfusions&r&l.&r

quests.title: Mining
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: Mining any types of ores will grant you Mining experience. However, you will only earn the full amount of experience from ores relative to your Mining level:
&eLv. 1-20&r (&7Tier 0&r): Coal, Iron, Copper
&eLv. 21-40&r (&aTier 1&r): Redstone, Lapis Lazuli, Gold, Quartz, Emerald
&eLv. 41-60&r (&9Tier 2&r): Cloggrum, Diamond, Froststeel, Utherium
&eLv. 61-80&r (&dTier 3&r): Regalium, Moonstone, Pyrope, Aquite
&eLv. 81-100&r (&6Tier 4&r): Falsite, Ventium, Horizonite
&eLv. 100&r (&5Tier 5&r): Charoite, Diopside
&cThat doesn't mean you won't receive any experience from items outside your level range, just less.&r

While mining, you will find Tiered Ore&r (&7Spritual&r, &aCelestial&r. &9Emyprean&r, &dAngelic&r, &6Divine&r, and &5Godly&r, which drop by chance depending on your level and the level range of the ore you are mining. This ore can be used in other Professions.

quests.title: Farming
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: Farming and harvesting produce will grant you Farming experience. However, you will only earn the full amount of experience from plants relative to your Farming level:
&eLv. 1-20&r (&7Tier 0&r): Wheat, Beetroot, Carrot, Potatoes
&eLv. 21-40&r (&aTier 1&r): Melon, Pumpkin, Flax, Cabbage, Tomato, Onion, Cocoa Beans
&eLv. 41-60&r (&9Tier 2&r): Corn, Gysahl Green, Nether Wart, Rice, Gloomgourd
&eLv. 61-80&r (&dTier 3&r): Pine Fruit, Winter Leaves
&eLv. 81-100&r (&6Tier 4&r): Scalefruit, Fiery Beans
&eLv. 100&r (&5Tier 5&r): Cryoroot, Solnut
&cThat doesn't mean you won't receive any experience from items outside your level range, just less.&r

While harvesting, you will find &eTiered Produce&r (&7Spritual&r, &aCelestial&r. &9Emyprean&r, &dAngelic&r, &6Divine&r, and &5Godly&r), which drop by chance depending on your level and the level range of the plant you are harvesting. These can then be used in other Professions.

quests.title: Fishing
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: Fishing any fish will grant you Fishing experience.

While fishing, you will find &eTiered Fish&r (&7Spritual&r, &aCelestial&r. &9Emyprean&r, &dAngelic&r, &6Divine&r, and &5Godly&r), which drop by chance depending on your level. For example, &7Spiritual&r Fish drop while your Fishing level is between 1-20, &aCelestial&r while your level is between 21-40, etc. The fish can then be used in other Professions.

quests.title: Bounty Hunting
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: &eBounty Hunting&r is a Mine and Slash Profession which levels up as you complete Bountiful bounties. Complete bounties to earn Bounty Hunting experience and &eBounty Slips&r!

&eBounty Boards&r will generate &erandom bounties&r for you to complete. Take out a &erequest&r from the board's interface and complete it within the &etime limit&r to earn the listed rewards. As you complete bounties, your &ereputation&r (tied to that Bounty Board block) will increase, increasing the level of rewards. Empowered Bounty Slips will start appearing at 45 reputation!

As you level your Bounty Hunting, you will gain access to more purchasable rewards in the &eProfession Shop&r. Items in this shop are purchasable with &eBounty Slips&r! The shop can be accessed with &eDefault Key: P, or the menu wheel&r.
Craft &eDecrees&r to give new quest types to the board per decree type, which is randomly determined.
Through Bounty Hunting you will be able to gain &eTiered Meats&r (&7Spritual&r, &aCelestial&r. &9Emyprean&r, &dAngelic&r, &6Divine&r, and &5Godly&r) to be used in Cooking.

quests.title: Professions Overview
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: Mine and Slash adds its very own Profession system. Professions are split into 3 categories:
&e&lGathering:&r&r
- &7Mining&r: gather materials while mining.
- &2Farming&r: gather materials when harvesting produce.
- &9Fishing&r: gather special fish by chance while fishing.
- &6Bounty Hunting&r: complete bounties for rewards.
&e&lCrafting:&r&r
- &eGear Crafting&r: craft gear to be used in combat.
- &eInfusing&r: craft scrolls to enhance your gear.
- &cCooking&r: cook up foods that provide stat, drop, and experience bonuses for a period of time upon consumption.
- &5Alchemy&r: create powerful brews to enhance your stats for a period of time.
&e&lOther:&r&r
- &4Salvaging&r: extract resources from gear when salvaged in a Salvaging Station &e(you can also enable auto-salvaging through the Hub)&r.
&c&lNote: Professions cannot be leveled beyond your Mine and Slash level!&r&r

quests.title: Leveling Tools
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions Lost Page

quests.title: Increasing Gear Quality
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: &eSharpening Stones&r can be used on your gear to increase their potency. The quality increase is reflected in the gear's base stat (Weapon Damage, Armor, Dodge Rating, etc.).
You can craft &eSharpening Stones&r in the &eGear Crafting Station&r using Stones. As you find higher rarity Stones, you will be able to craft better &eSharpening Stones&r.
These &eSharpening Stones&r can push quality above the normal cap of &b20&r, so they should always be used after &eOrbs of Quality&r as &eSharpening Stones&r can only be used once on an item!

quests.title: Not Vanilla Enchantments
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: Craft an &eUncommon Armor Infusion&r with the following:
3x &7Spiritual Ore&r
1x &aUncommon Stone&r
2x Iron Ingot
1x Leather
1x Paper
5x Copper Coin
When used on your Gear, you have a chance of applying a random stat as a bonus. You can then upgrade that stat by applying higher rarity Infusions.

&cThe Infusion has a chance of failure when used&r, but you will see the item's tooltip update with "Infusion" once successful. &cInfusions must be applied in rarity order.&r Meaning you must start with a successful common Infusion before applying an uncommon one. You cannot apply a rare Infusion onto an item with a common Infusion. The colour of the "Infusion" tooltip denotes the rarity of the infusion.

quests.title: Soul Modification
quests.subtitle: M\&S Professions
description: When using a &eCrafted Gear Soul&r, there is a &cchance&r it will roll as any one of the armor types. To circumvent this randomness, you can use &eSoul Modifiers&r.
You can apply &eSoul Modifiers&r directly onto &eCrafted Gear Souls&r to &eguarantee the material (plate, cloth, leather) outcome&r of your item.
There are also &eSoul Modifiers&r for the various hybrid armor sets!

Use the &eSoul Modifier&r on the &eCrafted Gear Soul&r by dragging and dropping it. You may not notice any changes, but once the &eCrafted Gear Soul&r is used, you will see that it belongs to that type.
For example, apply a &eCloth Soul Modifier&r onto a &eCrafted Armor Soul&r to guarantee Cloth Armor!
